planets.name: HAT-P-8 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-8 with a 3.08-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: HAT-P-8 b was found in 2008 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-8. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2008, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.07634347, pl_radj 1.4, pl_bmassj 1.28

quotes.title: HAT-P-8b
quotes.card: HAT-P-8b is an extrasolar planet located approximately 720 light years away in the constellation of Pegasus, orbiting the 10th magnitude star GSC 02757-01152.
quotes.introduction: This planet was discovered by transit on December 5, 2008.
